title: Laudable Uruguayan Chivito Empanadas
description: A show-off Uruguayan dish featuring piccalilli, double-fried chicken, and ayurvedic rajasic-friendly ingredients, resulting in a sour and crumbly taste.
instructions: Mix together flour, water, and salt to create the empanada dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of the double-fried chicken mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Add a spoonful of piccalilli, onion, garlic, and emmental cheese on top of the chicken.
Fold the other half of the dough circle over the filling to form a half-circle shape.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add the empanadas and fry for 4 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy!
